id: title:Gilbert09:open a delta table without a separate existence check

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion paths: P1.F3 and P1.F7 implement the warehouse connector's handling of missing tables, while P1.F11 and P1.F12 support warehouse ingestion and test helpers.
review.reason: Adds optional parameters to skip existence checks and retain created table handles, reducing redundant requests and preserving state in warehouse ingestion. P1.F3 and P1.F7 implement the warehouse connector's handling of missing tables, while P1.F11 and P1.F12 support warehouse ingestion and test helpers.
review.uncertainty: Exact recovery or behavior change not demonstrated; tier relies on implementation and relevant checks rather than unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are supported. No tier assignment is made; this is an observation-only pass.

observations.behavior: Adds an optional expect_missing parameter to DeltaTableRef, allowing callers to skip existence checks when a table is known or expected to be absent.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces redundant object-store requests and latency in warehouse ingestion paths where a table may not exist, while retaining the ability to discover newly created tables.

observations.behavior: Records the missing-table state and the expect_missing hint, and adds an adopt_created_table method to retain the handle of a table created by the caller.
observations.code_quote: self._expect_missing = is_first_sync if expect_missing is None else expect_missing
observations.posthog_connection: Preserves the cached table handle after creation, avoiding redundant re-opening and maintaining consistency with the write stream.

observations.behavior: Adds allow_known_missing parameter and early-return path when a missing table is already known, skipping the existence check.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows callers to skip the existence check entirely when they already know the table is missing, further reducing latency and request count.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a test and implementation change group. P1.F5 and P1.F6 are tests; P1.F7, P1.F8, P1.F9, P1.F10 are implementation. No score assigned. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds expect_missing parameter to DeltaTableRef and its callers, and adds allow_known_missing to get_delta_table. P1.F7.H1, P1.F8.H1, P1.F9.H1, P1.F10.H1.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion to distinguish between a table that is known missing and one that is not, and to avoid unnecessary existence checks when overwriting. P1.F8.H1, P1.F9.H1, P1.F10.H1.

observations.behavior: Adds adopt_created_table call after creating a table. P1.F7.H2, P1.F7.H3.
observations.posthog_connection: Records a table that was created by another writer, rather than treating it as missing. P1.F7.H3.

observations.behavior: Adds expect_missing to DeltaTableRef constructor. P1.F8.H1, P1.F9.H1, P1.F10.H1.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion to pass a known missing state to DeltaTableRef, and to avoid unnecessary existence checks when overwriting. P1.F9.H1, P1.F10.H1.
